messages:
Sam T: Heads up — planning a progressive rollout for api-service v2 today. Target deploy window 16:30–17:00 PT. Who can own the smoke checks? :rocket:
Anya R: I can own smoke. Plan: deploy to staging -> run health + common prompts -> prod canary 2% -> 10% -> 50%. I'll post smoke commands.
Mike L: Are we gating by geo? prefer to start in us-west only for first 2% then expand.
Jess K: I'll standby for logs and tracing. If anything >3% error I'll rollback.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment job created: job/rel-2026-03-17-2412345678 -> eta 16:45 PT. CI artifacts: build-984
Sam T: Thanks. Anya, can you paste the health checks and rollback steps?
Anya R: Quick checks:
```
curl -sS https://api.us-west.redwood.internal/health | jq .
curl -sS https://api.us-west.redwood.internal/annotate -d '{"prompt":"ping"}'
```
Smoke checklist: 1) 200 responses for /health 2) p95 latency < 120ms 3) model outputs within expected tokens 4) no errors in routing logs.
Rollback steps: terraform rollback job, scale down service to previous task set, toggle routing to stable v1.
Mike L: Cohort list: us-west-prod only for 2%, then add eu-west for 10%. Any objections?
Jess K: No objections. I'll watch traces and kick off manual regression tests at 10% :eyes: 
Sam T: Also, @security please confirm there's no new permission changes — pinging offline.
Anya R: I'll be ready to hit rollback within 5m of detecting anomaly. We'll use the rollback playbook: https://confluence.redwood/release/playbooks/rollback
Mike L: One last ask — @eng-releases can someone add a quick note to the release board when we hit each step? Prefer automated but manual is fine.
Jess K: I'll update the board after my checks. :white_check_mark:
Sam T: Perfect. Let's do a final sync 15 min before window in #eng-releases. Thanks team.
